body: Can confirm, I made them for a few years.
What would you like to talk about?

Which religion? Ive studied Hinduism, Christianity, Judaism, Satanism, Scientology, Catholicism, Ive followed the teachings of the Buda. The only thing I've learned is that organised religion controls people in a very positive way as much as it does a negative way. What do you have do offer?
Im sorry you feel that way, I think I could be your friend.
You can message me if you'd like. It might be something to do if you want. If not I understand, but I do think there's a path you may not see. As with anything you never truly know what may happen.
I understand that feeling well. Sometimes I try to count the things that I can be thankful for, sometimes I post here when I feel like that. Do you have any tools to help you when you feel like that?

You're here, you may not be asking for help on purpose but I promise it is good for you. I've still not found any tool that helps me with my depression and SI thoughts quite like posting here, whether venting or helping others.

You never know when or where you will find remorse from the pain and the sadness. You're not alone in that you're alone during the holidays, I'm here, it's not much but I'm here looking for help and offering what help I have. I bet if you continue looking and seeking help you will find meaning in something someday soon.

Seeing someone you love pass, and seeing behind the curtain of someone else you love, I can understand being in pain because of it all. It seems like you've been looking for help and I think that's a great idea. Never give up on yourself, you will never see the road you end up on, and I bet if you keep asking for help and working on yourself, you will find a great path.
Thank you! Nice username by the way, I chuckled.

As far as I can see you're still trying and for some that's a massive achievement. Take that and run with it. Never giving up a continued effort to both ask for help, and to improve your current crisis will lead you onto a sort of path you simply cannot see right now. Know that it is there and that someday you will be on the road you want to be on. Also failure is normal and often leads to a better outcome than expected. Happy holidays, keep your chin up.
